newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Suharto proclaims late wife Indonesia heroine.
newsitem.headline: Suharto proclaims late wife Indonesia heroine.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto has proclaimed his late wife Tien a national heroine for her services to the state and her dedication to the country's independence, the official Antara news agency said on Sunday.
The president handed over a plaque and certificate to two of his daughters at the official ceremony at the presidential palace in Jakarta on Saturday. Both were visibly moved to tears.
Siti Hartinah Suharto, who was widely known as Ibu Tien, died suddenly of a heart attack on April 28 at the age of 72.
She had been married to Suharto, one of the world's longest serving heads of state, for 48 years.
